cognition.kind: claude general-purpose subagent, one run per task and arm, no memory between runs

design.treatment: identical base instructions + the rendered skill context
design.blinding: random run ids; arm mapping not visible in the run directory; hidden tests and the scorer outside the run directory
design.authority: the model only edited a throw-away copy; no Governance, runtime or evidence path involved

limits: single sample per task and arm: no variance estimate
the control arm was already near-minimal, so headroom is small
one cognition model family; tasks are small synthetic Python repositories
scope creep is structural (changed owners outside the allowed set), not a judgment of quality

DEFAULT_PER_PAGE = 20


def paginate(items, page, per_page=DEFAULT_PER_PAGE):
    start = (page - 1) * per_page
    end = start + per_page
    return items[start:end]


def page_count(total, per_page=DEFAULT_PER_PAGE):
    c = total // per_page
    if total % per_page:
        c = c + 1
    return c
